reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is heteroskedasticity in PropFinder scores across NFL markets. A single global linear model fails because the scoring distribution shifts from near-deterministic (binary) to probabilistic (50/50). This necessitates regime-based modeling. In GSI, this maps to adaptive conformal prediction where each market gets its own calibration curve. In GSE, it triggers different reasoning states: for high-value markets we use certainty propagation, for balanced markets we use risk-neutral valuation. The key failure mode is assuming stationarity across all markets.
